name: Beam
line: Website analytics with pageview, referrer and campaign reports.

free.text: Free for one site up to 50,000 pageviews/month

pv.math: 10,000 pageviews fit inside the free monthly limit of 50,000.
100,000 pageviews is more than the free limit, but fits the Pro limit of 500,000 a month.
1,000,000 pageviews is more than the listed 500,000 Pro limit. No published plan covers that amount.
